comparison.objective: Replace a frayed camera cable in the same USB port while stabilizing the hub and respecting operation order; no spec versions are available.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual hub stabilization, straight plug extraction, small-port insertion, and ordered tool/object handling.
comparison.success_condition: Old plug goes to the bin before the new one leaves its dock; new plug is fully inserted into the original port, no other port is entered, and arms return home.
comparison.reason: Although both require small-feature alignment and bimanual stabilization, USB extraction/insertion tests connector mating and sequencing; the candidate explicitly tests impact-driven sacrificial fracture and recovery of resulting fragments.
